responses.value: With enrollment up 15%, the added students are likely less prepared for college work, so more leave. I'd compare first-year dropout for new and other students, by placement-test score.
Revise: dropout rose only for program students, who work 25 hours a week, so the cause is work pressure.
Dropout among program students by hours worked a week. If those working 25 hours left no more often than those working little, I'd drop it.
